literal.prompt: На тропе национального парка вам навстречу идут другие посетители. Как NPS советует поступить?
answers: Продолжить идти по центру тропы, не обращая внимания на встречных.
Вежливо уступить им дорогу на тропе.
Сойти с тропы и обойти их по растительности.

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks a common shared-trail courtesy action in a national park. NPS Leave No Trace principle 7 explicitly says respect other visitors, be courteous, and yield to other trail users. Key index 1 expresses that rule. The other answers contradict that guidance.

literalGroups.literal: NPS рекомендует быть внимательными к другим посетителям и уступать им дорогу на тропе. Это помогает всем сохранить хорошее впечатление от прогулки.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS explicitly instructs visitors to respect other visitors, protect their experience, be courteous and yield to other users on trails. The two sentences restate this support and implication without claiming a guarantee.

literalGroups.literal: NPS советует быть внимательными к другим посетителям и уступать им дорогу на тропе.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS Principle #7 directs visitors to respect other visitors, protect the quality of their experience, be courteous, and yield to other users on the trail. These exact statements support the literal note; the separate durable-trail advice does not support this note.

literalGroups.literal: При встрече с вьючными животными NPS рекомендует встать с нижней стороны тропы.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS says to step to the downhill side of a trail when encountering pack stock. This is an additional concrete courtesy rule for a distinct encounter and is beyond the question/key.

literalGroups.literal: NPS призывает уважать других посетителей и уступать им дорогу на тропе.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS tells visitors to be courteous, respect others’ experience, and yield to other trail users; the note corrects the idea that a group should demand precedence.

literalGroups.literal: На популярных маршрутах NPS рекомендует держаться существующей тропы даже в грязь.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS advises staying on existing trails in popular areas and walking in the middle even when wet or muddy; leaving the trail through vegetation conflicts with that advice.

absoluteDifficulty.basis: A single-step social courtesy norm on a shared walking path: yielding politely to other trail users is broadly familiar to adult visitors and does not require park-name, specialist ecology, or agency-specific rule recall. Context itself makes the situation clear. The niche pack-stock instruction appears only as an extra note, not needed to solve the question.
